Coram : H.S. BEDI, C.K. PRASAD
Penal Code, 1860: A B c ss. 302 and 364 - Two children aged 3 and 7, burnt to death by friend of their mother - Conviction by trial court with death sentence - High Court commuted the sentence and directed that accused should not be released unless he had served at least 20 years of imprisonment - The Court endorses the finding of the trial court that crime committed by the accused was indeed barbaric and called for no mercy - But in view of the facts that pending appeal the accused has already completed his sentence of 20 years and has been released, it would be a complete travesty of
Decision Date : 17-08-2010 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 1059/2004 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
